summary: B1: core model and the folder store
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub-Plugins `9f3d507`: B1: Board Core — model (issues with types, statuses, priorities, people, labels, components, fix versions, story points, time tracking, links, comments, attachments, custom fields; workflows; board definitions; versions), JSON files with stable bytes and kept unknown fields, LexoRank-style ranks, Jira-style durations, IBoardStore + the folder store (lock, temp-file rename, compare-and-swap on .version, outside changes), BoardSnapshot, operations as plain argument objects with a change log per issue (IssueFields: one place for every field's rules), BoardSession (write queue, retry after a conflict, reload, undo), BoardSettings; 113 tests
